verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs say teams and invited collaborators can comment on both preview and production environments, through an in-browser toolbar for leaving feedback. First-party marketplace integrations extend this with Slack notifications for comments and comment-to-issue conversion for GitHub, Jira and Linear. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the commenting workflow (the evidence is one-line summaries), and independent or hands-on corroboration that commenting works as described.
